name: DLR RECORD139 · local-frame measured-knots
source: Timo Schumacher; Henri Siller; DLR; https://zenodo.org/records/20494053
coverage_notes: Real measured audio and receiver coordinates, but no absolute geography or UTC. Local x/y/z are embedded as east/north/up at arbitrary (0,0,0); output is not a geographic geolocation.
Zero-based reference samples interpreted as simultaneous source-state clock; source does not explicitly distinguish emission/reception convention. No alignment is fitted using receiver truth.
All channels are correlated observations of one flight. Uniform wind is supplied from the published 90-degree reference.
Source positions are original three measured knots; no source trajectory extrapolation.
